# Repository purpose

This repository is the `tikoci` organization's special public `.github` repository for shared GitHub defaults and documentation.

# What belongs here

Keep organization-wide, public-safe community health defaults and documentation here.

Examples include shared contribution guidance, support guidance, security reporting guidance, and documentation about how GitHub and Copilot settings are expected to work across the organization.

# What does not automatically propagate from here

Do not assume repository-local Copilot files in this repository apply to other repositories.

Files such as `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and `.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml` only affect the repository that contains them unless GitHub documentation explicitly says otherwise.

# Editing guidance

Prefer small documentation-first changes.

When changing guidance here, keep it accurate to current GitHub behavior and update `README.md` if the user-facing explanation changes.

Keep all content safe to expose publicly.
